summary: Free desktop terminal for financial research with market analytics, AI chat and a quant lab, as an open alternative to costly terminals.

heroCommands.command: Get the installer for Windows, Linux or macOS from GitHub Releases

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Fincept Terminal is a native C++20 desktop app for financial research, with a Qt6 interface and embedded Python analytics in one binary. It offers market analytics, AI chat and a quant research lab, as a free open-source alternative to closed, expensive financial terminals.
sixtySeconds.problem: Professional financial terminals cost a lot. Fincept gives individuals and small teams research tools for free.
whoFor: Analysts who want a free terminal
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a fast native app with AI features and analytics, free to use, with optional paid account tiers for more cloud credits.
requirements: Windows x64, Linux x64 (Flatpak or Ubuntu 22.04+/Debian 12+), or macOS Apple Silicon

overview: Download the installer for your platform from the latest release: a Windows setup exe, a Linux Flatpak or deb, or a macOS dmg for Apple Silicon. You can also build from source with ./setup.sh on Linux and macOS.
The open-source repo is the free AGPL edition. A Fincept account is free, or Pro at $10 a month for more cloud credits and higher API limits, per the README.
A separate closed-source Enterprise edition exists for funds and research desks. Nothing here is investment advice.
limitations: Some data and AI features use cloud credits
macOS build is Apple Silicon only
